atoms.text:
Scene 1: Rachel and Joey sit on a sofa, snow is falling outside the window. Dad enters the room.

Dad: Kids, let’s get the house in order for Mum. I bet it would make her happy to come home to a clean house after a long day of working at the hospital.

Rachel: (annoyed) Dad, you know I’m allergic to scented soap. No way am I doing the washing up.

Joey: (rolling his eyes) You’re not even allergic, you’re just making that up!

Dad: Stop it, Joey. (frustrated) And Rachel, you could just hoover instead, that would help me out a lot.

atoms.text:
Joey: (laughing) Ha, I bet you thought you could get out of cleaning!

(Rachel huffs and leaves the room. A hoover can be heard offstage.)

Dad: Not so fast, Joey. Let’s make a deal: either you do the washing up or clean the toilet.

Joey: Yuck! Fine, I’ll do the washing up. (Walks to the kitchen.)

(The kids finish their chores and start helping with dinner. Mum enters stage left, through the front door looking tired. When she sees the dinner table she smiles and hugs her family.)

Mum: Wow! (With a big smile on her face.) Thank you so much! That just made my day.
